// Stand-ins for the app's design system, state and models, with the
// signatures its pages use. App widgets paint or lay out from app code, so a
// design places them as islands, as the app's own do.

import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

// Tokens.

abstract final class KitSpace {
  static const double xs = 6;
  static const double s = 8;
  static const double m = 14;
  static const double l = 20;
  static const double xl = 28;
  static const double x3 = 40;
  static const double gridGap = 10;
}

abstract final class KitRadius {
  static const double xl = 28;
}

abstract final class KitSize {
  static const double minTap = 44;
}

abstract final class KitIconSize {
  static const double small = 18;
}

abstract final class KitType {
  static const display = TextStyle(fontSize: 34, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700);
  static const headline = TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600);
  static const title = TextStyle(fontSize: 28, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600);
  static const lede = TextStyle(fontSize: 17);
  static const body = TextStyle(fontSize: 16);
  static const secondary = TextStyle(fontSize: 15);
  static const captionLarge = TextStyle(fontSize: 13);
  static const overline = TextStyle(fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 1.2);
  static const sceneName = TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600);
}

final class KitColors {
  const KitColors._();
  Color get ink => const Color(0xFF15211B);
  Color get ink2 => const Color(0xFF51605A);
  Color get ground => const Color(0xFFF6F3EC);
  Color get fade => const Color(0x00F6F3EC);
  Color get primary => const Color(0xFF2F6B4F);
  Color get lilac => const Color(0xFFE7E0F5);
  Color get lilacInk => const Color(0xFF5B4A86);
  static KitColors of(BuildContext context) => const KitColors._();
}

final class KitIconData {
  const KitIconData(this.codePoint);
  final int codePoint;
}

abstract final class KitIcons {
  static const sun = KitIconData(1);
  static const clock = KitIconData(2);
  static const home = KitIconData(3);
  static const moon = KitIconData(4);
  static const cup = KitIconData(5);
  static const drop = KitIconData(6);
  static const dropFilled = KitIconData(7);
  static const bell = KitIconData(8);
  static const star = KitIconData(9);
  static const chart = KitIconData(10);
  static const book = KitIconData(11);
  static const camera = KitIconData(12);
}

abstract final class KitMotion {
  static bool reduceMotionOf(BuildContext context) => false;
}

// A painter for the stand-ins: painting is app code a design can't express.
final class _Paint extends CustomPainter {
  const _Paint();
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {}
  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_Paint oldDelegate) => false;
}

Widget _painted(Widget child) =>
    CustomPaint(painter: const _Paint(), child: child);

// Widgets.

class KitBalancedText extends StatelessWidget {
  const KitBalancedText(this.text, {super.key, this.style, this.textAlign});
  final String text;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final TextAlign? textAlign;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) =>
            Text(text, style: style, textAlign: textAlign),
      );
}

class KitIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const KitIcon(this.icon, {super.key, this.size = 24, this.color});
  final KitIconData icon;
  final double size;
  final Color? color;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      _painted(SizedBox(width: size, height: size));
}

class KitTopBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const KitTopBar({
    super.key,
    this.onBack,
    this.onClose,
    this.center,
    this.trailingLabel,
    this.onTrailing,
    this.trailingSpace = false,
  });
  final VoidCallback? onBack;
  final VoidCallback? onClose;
  final Widget? center;
  final String? trailingLabel;
  final VoidCallback? onTrailing;
  final bool trailingSpace;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SizedBox(
        height: 56,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            GestureDetector(onTap: onBack ?? onClose, child: const Text('<')),
            Expanded(child: Center(child: center)),
            if (trailingLabel != null)
              GestureDetector(onTap: onTrailing, child: Text(trailingLabel!)),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class KitProgressDots extends StatelessWidget {
  const KitProgressDots({super.key, required this.step, required this.count});
  final int step;
  final int count;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _painted(SizedBox(width: count * 12));
}

enum KitButtonVariant { primary, ghost }

class KitButton extends StatelessWidget {
  // Not const: building one runs the app's code, as the app's own does.
  KitButton({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.icon,
    this.loading = false,
    this.done = false,
    this.variant = KitButtonVariant.primary,
  });
  final String label;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final KitIconData? icon;
  final bool loading;
  final bool done;
  final KitButtonVariant variant;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GestureDetector(
        onTap: loading ? null : onPressed,
        child: _painted(SizedBox(height: 52, child: Center(child: Text(label)))),
      );
}

class KitInput extends StatelessWidget {
  const KitInput.search({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    required this.hint,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String hint;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => EditableText(
        controller: controller,
        focusNode: FocusNode(),
        style: KitType.body,
        cursorColor: const Color(0xFF000000),
        backgroundCursorColor: const Color(0xFF000000),
        onChanged: onChanged,
      );
}

class PinnedBottomColumn extends StatelessWidget {
  const PinnedBottomColumn({
    super.key,
    required this.bottom,
    required this.children,
    this.padding = EdgeInsets.zero,
  });
  final EdgeInsets padding;
  final Widget bottom;
  final List<Widget> children;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CustomScrollView(
        slivers: [
          SliverPadding(
            padding: padding,
            sliver: SliverList(delegate: SliverChildListDelegate(children)),
          ),
          SliverFillRemaining(hasScrollBody: false, child: bottom),
        ],
      );
}

  final Widget child;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _painted(child);
}

// State management.

abstract class Bloc<E, S> extends ChangeNotifier {
  Bloc(this._state);
  S _state;
  S get state => _state;
  void emit(S state) {
    _state = state;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void add(E event) {}
}

final _blocs = <Type, Object>{};

extension BlocRead on BuildContext {
  T read<T>() => _blocs[T]! as T;
  V value<T, V>() => (_blocs[T]! as Bloc<Object?, V>).state;
}

class BlocSignalBuilder<B extends Bloc<Object?, S>, S> extends StatefulWidget {
  const BlocSignalBuilder({super.key, required this.builder});
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, S state) builder;
  @override
  State<BlocSignalBuilder<B, S>> createState() => _BlocSignalBuilderState<B, S>();
}

class _BlocSignalBuilderState<B extends Bloc<Object?, S>, S>
    extends State<BlocSignalBuilder<B, S>> {
  late final B _bloc = context.read<B>();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _bloc.addListener(_changed);
  }

  void _changed() => setState(() {});

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _bloc.removeListener(_changed);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.builder(context, _bloc.state);
}

class BlocSignalListener<B extends Bloc<Object?, S>, S>
    extends StatelessWidget {
  const BlocSignalListener({
    super.key,
    required this.listener,
    required this.child,
  });
  final void Function(BuildContext context, S state) listener;
  final Widget child;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => child;
}

// Models.

enum HomeMode { vivid, bright, medium, low }

enum ItemFilter { popular, easy, lowMode, shared }

enum AmountUnit { cups, ml }

final class TimeOfDayValue {
  const TimeOfDayValue(this.hour, this.minute);
  final int hour;
  final int minute;
  int get hour12 => hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  bool get pm => hour >= 12;
}

enum ReminderPreset {
  morning(TimeOfDayValue(8, 0)),
  lunch(TimeOfDayValue(12, 30)),
  evening(TimeOfDayValue(19, 0));

  const ReminderPreset(this.time);
  final TimeOfDayValue time;
}

final class ItemKind {
  const ItemKind(
    this.id,
    this.commonName, {
    this.difficulty = 'easy',
    this.lowModeOk = false,
    this.shared = false,
    this.riveFile = 'item.riv',
    this.riveArtboard = 'item',
  });
  final String id;
  final String commonName;
  final String difficulty;
  final bool lowModeOk;
  final bool shared;
  final String riveFile;
  final String riveArtboard;
}

final class ItemCatalog {
  const ItemCatalog(this.kind);
  final List<ItemKind> kind;
  ItemKind byId(String id) => kind.firstWhere((s) => s.id == id);
  List<ItemKind> search(String query) => [
        for (final s in kind)
          if (s.commonName.toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase())) s,
      ];
}

final class OnboardingState {
  const OnboardingState({
    this.selected = const [],
    this.names = const {},
    this.cheerTicks = const {},
    this.query = '',
    this.filter = ItemFilter.popular,
    this.mode = HomeMode.medium,
    this.time = const TimeOfDayValue(8, 0),
    this.preset,
    this.busy = false,
    this.waveTick = 0,
    this.grantedTick = 0,
  });
  final List<String> selected;
  final Map<String, String> names;
  final Map<String, int> cheerTicks;
  final String query;
  final ItemFilter filter;
  final HomeMode mode;
  final TimeOfDayValue time;
  final ReminderPreset? preset;
  final bool busy;
  final int waveTick;
  final int grantedTick;
}

sealed class OnboardingEvent {
  const OnboardingEvent();
}

final class BackPressed extends OnboardingEvent {
  const BackPressed();
}

final class SkipPressed extends OnboardingEvent {
  const SkipPressed();
}

final class ContinuePressed extends OnboardingEvent {
  const ContinuePressed();
}

final class GetStarted extends OnboardingEvent {
  const GetStarted();
}

final class BoardConfirmed extends OnboardingEvent {
  const BoardConfirmed();
}

final class RemindersAccepted extends OnboardingEvent {
  const RemindersAccepted();
}

final class RemindersDeclined extends OnboardingEvent {
  const RemindersDeclined();
}

final class ModeSelected extends OnboardingEvent {
  const ModeSelected(this.mode);
  final HomeMode mode;
}

final class KindToggled extends OnboardingEvent {
  const KindToggled(this.id);
  final String id;
}

final class SearchChanged extends OnboardingEvent {
  const SearchChanged(this.query);
  final String query;
}

final class FilterSelected extends OnboardingEvent {
  const FilterSelected(this.filter);
  final ItemFilter filter;
}

final class ReminderTimeChosen extends OnboardingEvent {
  const ReminderTimeChosen(this.time);
  final TimeOfDayValue time;
}

final class ItemRenamed extends OnboardingEvent {
  const ItemRenamed(this.id, this.name);
  final String id;
  final String name;
}

final class OnboardingBloc extends Bloc<OnboardingEvent, OnboardingState> {
  OnboardingBloc() : super(const OnboardingState());
}

final class NowCubit extends Bloc<Object?, DateTime> {
  NowCubit() : super(DateTime(2026));
}

enum PlusPeriod { yearly, monthly }

final class PlusProduct {
  const PlusProduct(this.period, this.priceLabel, this.breakdown, this.badge);
  final PlusPeriod period;
  final String priceLabel;
  final String breakdown;
  final String? badge;
}

final class PlusEntitlement {
  const PlusEntitlement(this.period, this.renewsAt);
  final PlusPeriod period;
  final DateTime renewsAt;
}

final class PlusCubit extends Bloc<Object?, PlusEntitlement?> {
  PlusCubit() : super(null);
}

enum PaywallStatus {
  idle,
  purchasing,
  celebrating,
  restoring,
  closed,
  failed,
  nothingToRestore,
}

final class PaywallState {
  const PaywallState({
    this.status = PaywallStatus.idle,
    this.selected = PlusPeriod.yearly,
    this.celebrateTick = 0,
  });
  final PaywallStatus status;
  final PlusPeriod selected;
  final int celebrateTick;
}

final class PaywallCubit extends Bloc<Object?, PaywallState> {
  PaywallCubit() : super(const PaywallState());
  List<PlusProduct> get products => const [
        PlusProduct(PlusPeriod.yearly, r'$29.99', r'$2.50 a month', 'Best'),
        PlusProduct(PlusPeriod.monthly, r'$3.99', 'Billed monthly', null),
      ];
  void select(PlusPeriod period) {}
  void purchase() {}
  void restore() {}
  void acknowledge() {}
}

final class ToastCubit extends Bloc<Object?, String?> {
  ToastCubit() : super(null);
  void show(String message) {}
}

// App services.

abstract final class AppConfig {
  static const int freeItemLimit = 3;
  static const int trialDays = 7;
  static const int trialReminderDay = 5;
}

enum AppLinks { terms, privacy }

final class AppClock {
  const AppClock();
  DateTime now() => DateTime(2026);
}

final class AppHaptics {
  const AppHaptics();
  void medium() {}
}

final class AppLinksOpener {
  const AppLinksOpener();
  void open(AppLinks link) {}
}

final class AppScope {
  const AppScope._();
  ItemCatalog get catalog => const ItemCatalog([
        ItemKind('alpha', 'Alpha'),
        ItemKind('beta', 'Beta', difficulty: 'medium'),
      ]);
  AppClock get clock => const AppClock();
  AppHaptics get haptics => const AppHaptics();
  AppLinksOpener get links => const AppLinksOpener();
  static AppScope of(BuildContext context) => const AppScope._();
}

abstract final class AppCopy {
  static String time(TimeOfDayValue time) =>
      '${time.hour12}:${time.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} '
      '${time.pm ? 'PM' : 'AM'}';
  static String shortDate(DateTime date) => '${date.month}/${date.day}';
  static String homeModeSummary(HomeMode mode) => mode.name;
  static String reminderBody(int amount, AmountUnit unit) =>
      'Add $amount ${unit.name}.';
}

Future<String?> showRenameSheet(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String currentName,
}) async =>
    null;
